title: Hushed Storage
description: Provides a (Hushed) version of many blocks to make hidden storage and custom maps more fun
body:
# Welcome to Hushed Storage
- This mod gives you the ability to turn almost any block into a hidden chest simply by adding a chest and the block into a crafting grid.
- This mod will also support many other popular mods and allow you to turn them into storage.
- We make use of the provided images from other mods and their blocks so that the storage or as we call it "hushed" variant is indistinguishable from the normal block (without using F3)
- This mod, by the way it has been made is compatible with ANY resource pack that changes the default block textures.
